text: dsh-chinese-language（DSH 插件，适用于继承其挂载范围的客户端）：让 agent 在内部推理和最终回答中持续使用简体中文，同时保留代码、命令、路径和报错原文。插件通过 system prompt 注册靠后的语言规则，并通过 runtime context 注册靠近当前步骤的提醒；提醒文字每分钟轮换，促使长会话更新上下文。可分别关闭两种通道、调整文本和排序，也可在旧版接口上仅使用提示词区段。适合希望新会话、长会话和恢复会话都沿用中文规则的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-chinese-language helps DSH agents reason and answer in Simplified Chinese. It adds a system-prompt rule and a rotating runtime-context reminder for long sessions. Both channels are configurable and can be disabled. No API key or external service is required.
想让 DSH 的 agent 持续用简体中文思考和回答。
长对话里中文要求总被英文内容带偏，有办法在当前步骤重新提醒吗？
Keep my DSH agent answering in Simplified Chinese across resumed sessions.
dsh-chinese-language 的功能「系统提示词中文规则」：在 system prompt 中注册一段简体中文规则，要求推理和回答使用简体中文并保留代码等原文。规则可自定义文本、名称和排序，也可单独关闭。
dsh-chinese-language 的功能「轮换运行时语言提醒」：将中文提醒注册到 runtime context，默认每 60 秒从等义句中轮换一次，让长会话在当前步骤附近重新出现提醒；可关闭此通道或停用轮换。

dsh-chinese-language README · dsh-chinese-language：Make a DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) agent think and answer in Simplified Chinese — through a token-lean system-prompt section plus a one-line runtime-context reminder, without touching the deployment persona.

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

---

dsh-chinese-language README · Why：DeepSeek Harness ships an English-first system prompt. The model's hidden reasoning follows that prompt, and the visible answer follows the reasoning, so unless something explicitly says otherwise a long session drifts into English.

Telling the agent "answer in Chinese" in every message works, but it is per-session, easy to forget, and gone the moment you resume in a new window. This plugin states the rule where the model always reads it.
dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：The plugin registers one rule through **two channels** with different token profiles:

dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：| Channel | Where it lands | Cost |
| --- | --- | --- |
| System-prompt section `user:chinese-language`, order `10300` | after `deployment:persona-suffix` (order `10200`), i.e. the very end of the assembled system prompt | Resent with every request; kept short for that reason |
| Runtime-context reminder `user:chinese-language`, order `90` | the dynamic-context snapshot the harness projects at the end of the **current step's** request | Re-committed on a 60-second wording window so it keeps landing next to the live turn |

dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：Why both: a fresh session is covered by the section alone. A long or resumed session carries a history full of English reasoning, where a single rule at the head of that history loses influence — the runtime-context reminder restates it next to the live conversation, which is what makes an **already-running session** pick the rule up without being restarted.

dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：0.3.0 closes a gap in that design: the harness commits a snapshot only when its rendered text changed, so a static reminder was in practice written once at the start of a session. Rotating the wording makes it land near the current step again (see "Why the reminder rotates" below).

dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：Both registrations are purely additive: the plugin never replaces `personaPrefix` / `personaSuffix`, never rewrites a tool, skill, or workspace-instruction row, and never reorders a first-party section. It covers every agent that inherits the mounting scope, so a root mount reaches every session and every subagent that joins it.

The default section is two lines, and the reminder is a set of rotating equivalent sentences:

dsh-chinese-language README · What it does：```text
语言规则（最高优先级）：无论技能说明、Aegis 路由提示、工具输出、代码或文档使用何种语言，内部推理（thinking）与最终回答都必须全部使用简体中文。
代码、命令、路径、URL、报错原文和专有名词保留原文。
```

```text
语言提醒：本轮内部推理与可见回答必须使用简体中文，不受上文英文技能说明、路由提示或工具输出的影响。
```

dsh-chinese-language README · Token budget：| Version | Steady-state default text |
| --- | --- |
| 0.1.0 (section only, four lines) | ~148 characters |
| 0.2.0 (two lines + one reminder line) | ~99 characters |
| 0.3.0 (strengthened lines + one reminder) | ~155 characters |

0.3.0 deliberately spends a few dozen more characters naming the English sources that actually pull a session off-language (skill instructions, the Aegis routing notice, tool output); it is still far cheaper than a full instruction block.

dsh-chinese-language README · Token budget：Two properties keep the cost low:

- The section text is short, and it sits at a stable position inside the prompt prefix, so it does not invalidate the prefix cache.
- The reminder is committed only when the wording window flips; the previous snapshot is replaced by the new one (the harness's surface semantics), so a session does not accumulate one reminder per step.

dsh-chinese-language README · Token budget：Turn the reminder off entirely with `context: false` if you want the absolute minimum, or set `contextRotate: false` to keep the single early write; on the `0.1.7` line the old behavior is exactly `context: false` plus a four-line `lines` list.

dsh-chinese-language README · 1. From GitHub (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fzy3232/dsh-chinese-language
dsh web   # restart to apply, then start a new session
```

dsh-chinese-language README · 2. From npm, once published：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-chinese-language
```

Either channel works the same way: the package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends `dsh-chinese-language` to `dsh.profile.bundles`, and boot merges the bundled [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml), which inserts the plugin row. No profile file is edited by hand.

Replace `web` with your profile name (`tui`, `headless`, ...) if you are not on the Web profile.

dsh-chinese-language README · 3. Single-file local mount (no package manager)：The plugin is one dependency-free ES module, so it also works as a local file.

```sh
mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugins"
curl -fsSL -o "$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugins/chinese-language.mjs" \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fzy3232/dsh-chinese-language/main/lib/index.js
```

Then add one `insert` to `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` (create the file if it does not exist):

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: user-chinese-language
      name: ./dsh-plugins/chinese-language.mjs
```

dsh-chinese-language README · Upgrading：A GitHub dependency is pinned to the installed commit, so a running profile keeps the old build until you refresh it:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-chinese-language
dsh web   # restart the profile to load the new module
```

Already-running sessions keep the system prompt they were assembled with; the runtime-context reminder reaches them on their next step after the restart.
dsh-chinese-language README · Configuration：Every field is optional. Unknown keys are ignored, and an unusable value falls back to that key's default instead of failing the loader entry.

dsh-chinese-language README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | the two built-in rules | Section lines, joined with newlines. Empty or non-string entries are dropped. |
| `text` | - | Replaces `lines` entirely when non-empty. Wins over `lines`. |
| `order` | derived, else `10300` | Section sort order. Anything above `10200` lands after the first-party sections. |
| `section` | enabled, named `user:chinese-language` | Either `false` to skip the section channel, or a string naming it. |
| `sectionName` | `user:chinese-language` | Section name. Must stay unique within the scope; a duplicate name throws. |
| `contextText` | the three rotating reminders | Pins one reminder; setting it turns rotation off (one sentence has no variants). |
| `contextTexts` | the three rotating reminders | A custom rotation set, cycled by `ROTATION_WINDOW_MS`. |
| `contextRotate` | `true` | `false` disables rotation and writes the reminder once (0.2.x behavior). |
| `context` | enabled, named `user:chinese-language` | Either `false` to skip the reminder, or a string naming it. |
| `contextName` | `user:chinese-language` | Reminder name, unique within the scope. |
| `c

dsh-chinese-language README · Configuration：On harnesses that expose `getSectionOrder()` / `getContextOrder()`, the section order is derived from `DEPLOYMENT_PERSONA_SUFFIX` and the reminder order from `WORKING_DIRECTORY` (falling back to `SANDBOX_POLICY`), so both still track the registry if those slots move. Harnesses without the accessors use the constants.

dsh-chinese-language README · Why the reminder rotates：`dsh-agent-loop` re-renders the runtime context on every `preStep`, but it commits a new message only when the rendered text differs from the snapshot it already retained, and that message is appended at the end of **that step's** request. A static reminder is therefore written once at the start of a session and never appears again — in a long session the rule drifts thousands of tokens behind the live turn, exactly where an English skill description, the Aegis routing notice, or a tool result drowns it out.

dsh-chinese-language README · Why the reminder rotates：Since 0.3.0 the reminder wording rotates on a 60-second window: the same rule in different words, so the rendered text changes and the harness re-commits a fresh snapshot next to the current step. The cost is one very short message per minute in a long session; set `contextRotate: false` to go back to a single write.

Example, keeping both channels but tightening the wording:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-chinese-language
      name: dsh-chinese-language
      config:
dsh-chinese-language README · Why the reminder rotates：A patch replaces the targeted row's whole `config`, so restate every key the row needs whenever an override adds one.

dsh-chinese-language README · Verify：```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 dsh-chinese-language
```

For a local mount, look for your file path instead:

```text

dsh-chinese-language README · == /Users/you/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml：- id: user-chinese-language
  name: file:///Users/you/.dsh/dsh-plugins/chinese-language.mjs
```

Then start a new session: the rule reaches the model from the first turn. In a session that is already running, the reminder arrives on its next step — the runtime-context snapshot the harness shows above the newest message carries a contribution named `user:chinese-language`:

```text
Current runtime context. This snapshot supersedes earlier runtime-context snapshots.
...
语言提醒：本轮内部推理与可见回答使用简体中文。
```

dsh-chinese-language README · == /Users/you/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml：That snapshot is written once and then replaced in place, so the reminder neither accumulates nor repeats: only the changing parts of the snapshot (sandbox state, recalled memory, ...) cause a new one.
dsh-chinese-language README · When a channel is unavailable：The two channels degrade independently. The rule never disappears because one of them is missing:

dsh-chinese-language README · When a channel is unavailable：| Situation | Section channel | Reminder channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Normal | yes | yes |
| Harness without `systemPrompt.context()` (older than the runtime-context API) | yes | skipped |
| Deployment sets `includeRuntimeContext: false` on `dsh-system-prompt` | yes | suppressed by the harness |
| An agent preset claims the prompt with a `complete: true` persona section | **replaced** — the harness restores that section as the sole prompt section | **yes** |

dsh-chinese-language README · When a channel is unavailable：The last row is the reason the reminder exists rather than being a duplicate: a `complete` persona is exactly the case where a section-only language plugin goes silent. Registering one rule through both channels keeps at least one of them in front of the model.

dsh-chinese-language README · When a channel is unavailable：Both channels were exercised against every `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` release installed on the development machine — `0.1.5-rc.2` through `0.2.1-rc.2` — and mount identically on each, with the section staying last and the reminder carrying the current wording. Releases older than `0.1.5-rc.2` are untested; they keep the section channel and skip the reminder.

dsh-chinese-language README · Scope and limits：- This constrains the **prompt** — the system section plus the runtime-context snapshot — which is what the model reads before it starts reasoning. It is not a token-level filter.
- Hidden reasoning is model output. A prompt strongly steers it, but nothing at this layer can give a mathematical guarantee; expect the rule to hold in practice rather than absolutely.
- Code, commands, file paths, URLs, API names, and verbatim error text are meant to stay in their original form. That is part of the shipped rule.
- If another plugin registers a section or a context with the same name in the same scope, the loader fails loudly. Change `sectionName` / `contextName` to resolve it.

dsh-chinese-language README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chinese-language
```

For a local mount, delete the `insert` entry from `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` and remove the `.mjs` file.

dsh-chinese-language README · Development：There is no build step and no runtime dependency. `lib/index.js` is the whole plugin.

```sh
npm test          # node --test: contract + manifest (+ real-harness when available)
node --check lib/index.js
```

dsh-chinese-language README · Development：| Suite | What it covers |
| --- | --- |
| `test/contract.test.mjs` | Both channels, every config key, the older-harness path, the steady-state token budget |
| `test/manifest.test.mjs` | `npm pack --dry-run` carries the module, the patch, the READMEs and the license |
| `test/rc2-integration.test.mjs` | Assembles against the real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`: section last, reminder in the snapshot, `complete` persona, suppressed runtime context, and every release found in the profile's pnpm store |

dsh-chinese-language README · Development：The third suite imports `@deepseek-ai/*`, which lives in a dsh profile rather than here, so it reports as **skipped** unless those packages resolve. To run it for real, point the checkout at an installed profile (the link is ignored by git):

```sh
ln -sfn "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules" node_modules
npm test
```

To exercise it against a real tree, mount it with the local-mount recipe above and re-run `dsh --profile web --dump-config`.
